name: Cut Trees For Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to Cut Trees for Brainrots! 🌳

Clear your path through dense forests to find hidden Brainrots! 🪓
Swing your weapon and chop down trees to reach new zones! 🌲
Upgrade your damage to cut through tougher trees faster! 💥
Collect Brainrots to boost your income! 💸
Rebirth to earn even more and increase your attack radius! 🔁

Support the game with a Like and join the group for future updates! 👍
